# Gecko

> The knowledge graph for APIs your agent can trust. Open-source, runs on your machine.
> One command maps any API — even the messy, paywalled, or on-chain ones — into a
> verified graph your agent traverses instead of guessing. Every action can be simulated
> to a receipt before money moves, and every failure shows exactly why. Built for the
> calls your agent must not get wrong.

Gecko is NOT the agent and NOT an orchestrator. It is the memory-and-context substrate
under other people's agents: it comprehends external surfaces (REST APIs and Solana
programs), projects them as first-call-correct tools over MCP, verifies actions by
simulation before execution, and never signs, never broadcasts, never stores payloads
(control-plane invariant: surfaces + correctness metadata only).

The brand is Gecko; the PyPI package is `gecko-surf`, the import is `gecko`, the CLI is
`gecko`, and the repo is `GeckoVision/gecko-surf` (Apache-2.0).

## When an agent should reach for Gecko

Two axes — either one qualifies:

- A **messy surface**: paywalled, drifting, undocumented, or on-chain. The Nth painful
  API a coding agent does not one-shot.
- A **high-stakes action**: the agent runs unattended, holding credentials or moving
  money.

A clean API with a human reviewing the diff may not need Gecko. That is a real answer,
not a hedge.

## Use Gecko now (agents start here)

```
npx @geckovision/gecko doctor              # read-only environment check
npx @geckovision/gecko add <spec-or-docs>  # comprehend it — $0, no live call
npx @geckovision/gecko report <spec>       # the scorecard — grade + findings
npx @geckovision/gecko serve <spec>        # serve it over MCP
```

Then, from the agent: `search_capabilities("<what you want>")` → pick the ranked tool →
call it. Gecko builds the correct request and injects auth at call time; you never handle
a key. Going live is a separate, deliberate step: `gecko auth set <provider>` (the key
goes to your OS keychain, never into `mcp.json`).

On-chain: `gecko orquestra find-start "<intent>"` routes an intent to the right (program,
instruction) with a provenance-tagged derive plan; `gecko orquestra --program <name>
--stdio` serves the program surface.

## The four frames

- **Provenance on every edge** — extracted / recovered / flagged. Never fabricated;
  below the retrieval floor Gecko returns an honest no-start.
- **The receipt** — simulate on a $0 mainnet fork before money moves: status, a
  categorical revert class, compute units. A fork result is not mainnet, and a receipt
  never predicts price.
- **Drift** — a categorical, values-free corpus plus an N-confirmed drift detector, so
  you learn a provider broke you before production does.
- **Auth invisible to the agent** — credentials resolve from the OS keychain at call
  time and go only to the API's own host.

## Honest status

Proven: comprehension of 14+ real specs with 0 exposed auth headers; PDA seed recovery
from IDLs and from program source; auto-comprehend differential-proven on 4 mainnet
programs with measured overlays; the simulate→Receipt engine live-proven twice on a
surfpool mainnet fork (Pump.fun buy: naive reverts with AccountNotInitialized 3012,
Gecko passes at 86,669 CU; Meteora DLMM swap: wrap → swap → unwrap at 81,964 CU — CU
numbers measured per run, not mainnet); Meteora's 4-seed pool derivation
differential-proven against the stale 3-seed scheme; −77%/−89% measured context cuts on
two real specs; 2,400+ tests.

NOT built: the drift scheduler, hosted point-and-simulate, signing-gate binding to the
simulated message hash, the TEE credential backend, catalog breadth beyond 4 wired
programs, the semantic/vector retrieval tier (evidence-gated OFF), cross-customer
pooling, live x402 billing. Full split: https://docs.geckovision.tech/status

Gecko does not verify that the data an API returns is true.

## Agent integration

- [Hosted MCP endpoint](https://mcp.geckovision.tech/mcp): the live Gecko MCP (Streamable-HTTP) — one-click add to Claude or Cursor
- [llms-full.txt](https://docs.geckovision.tech/llms-full.txt): the whole docs as one Markdown file
- [gecko.json](https://docs.geckovision.tech/gecko.json): machine-readable manifest for these docs
- [/.well-known/gecko.json](https://docs.geckovision.tech/.well-known/gecko.json): the manifest at the discovery-convention path
- [Product manifest (canonical)](https://geckovision.tech/gecko.json): the source-of-truth product manifest on the landing
- [Landing](https://geckovision.tech): the product site — its own llms.txt + gecko.json

## Start here

- [Introduction](https://docs.geckovision.tech/introduction): the positioning, the four frames, who it's for, and the proof table.

## How it works

- [How comprehension works](https://docs.geckovision.tech/comprehension): ingest → catalog → question-shaped tools → correct request.
- [find_start](https://docs.geckovision.tech/find-start): intent → the right starting point, with the provenance-tagged derive plan and the honesty floor.
- [From docs](https://docs.geckovision.tech/from-docs): recovering a draft spec from a human docs page.
- [Recorded mode](https://docs.geckovision.tech/recorded-mode): one code path, two modes; $0 offline falsification.
- [Access & auth](https://docs.geckovision.tech/access-and-auth): the `Session.auth_headers()` seam and keychain-resolved credentials.
- [Stay correct](https://docs.geckovision.tech/stay-correct): content-addressed surfaces, the categorical corpus, the N-confirmed drift detector.

## On-chain

- [The Program Surface](https://docs.geckovision.tech/program-surface): recovering the PDA seeds an IDL drops, proven on four mainnet programs.
- [The Receipt](https://docs.geckovision.tech/receipt): what a Receipt asserts and what it deliberately does NOT.

## For AI agents

- [The MCP surface](https://docs.geckovision.tech/mcp-surface): `list_tools` / `call_tool`, the synthetic `search_capabilities` tool, and `serve_stdio`.
- [Agent discoverability](https://docs.geckovision.tech/discoverability): intent → endpoint, hidden auth, surfacing only the calls that will work.
